mentions.name: Subarctic mine discrete event simulation (pysim)
mentions.description: This tool is a discrete event simulation built with pysim that models scoop-truck movement and loading operations at a subarctic mine. It evaluates the efficacy of operational designs and forecasts productivity for the mine's autonomous vehicles program and underground control center.
mentions.problem: The mine's autonomous vehicles program and underground control center lacked a means to evaluate the efficacy of designs and forecast productivity.
mentions.source_excerpt: Work wise I'm building a discrete event simulation with pysim. I manage the autonomous vehicles program and underground control center for the subarctic mine I work at, and we've desperately needed some means to evaluate efficacy of designs and forecast productivity. Using it to model scoop-truck movement and loading operations, and it's working very well.
